def find_permutation_with_decreasing_coefficient(n, k):
    # Start with a sorted permutation
    perm = list(range(1, n + 1))
    
    # We need to create a decreasing sequence of length k
    # We can achieve this by performing k swaps starting from the end of the list

def find_permutation_with_decreasing_coefficient(n, k):
    # Start with the list [1, 2, ..., n]
    permutation = list(range(1, n + 1))
    
    # We need to create exactly k inversions
    # We will perform swaps to achieve this
    for i in range(n - 1, n - 1 - k, -1):
        for j in range(i, 0, -1):
            # Perform a swap to create an inversion
            permutation[j], permutation[j - 1] = permutation[j - 1], permutation[j]

    print(" ".join(map(str, permutation)))
